user.title: PA
user.description: Where the PA is, and the token from its .env.

data_description.url: The address the PA answers on, such as http://192.168.1.10:7870. Not the socket: the socket is found from it.

reconfigure.title: PA
reconfigure.description: Correct the address or the token. The check is the same one, and it reads the PA's answer rather than only its status code — which is what stops a missing port being accepted.

data_description.url: The address the PA answers on, such as http://192.168.1.10:7870. Not the socket: the socket is found from it.
data_description.token: PA_SERVER_TOKEN from the PA's .env. Leave it blank to keep the one this is already using.

error.cannot_connect: That address is not the PA. If it is this machine, it needs the port — usually 7870, as in http://192.168.1.10:7870.

abort.already_configured: That PA is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The PA's address has been changed.
